text: Pestana Alvor Praia is a five-star hotel on the cliff above Praia dos Três Irmãos, just outside Alvor, with a lift down to the beach. The closest golf course is Pestana's own [Alto Golf](/courses/alto-golf), about **6 minutes** away by car, and the two Sir Henry Cotton courses at [Penina](/courses/penina-championship) are about 18. **Last checked: November 2026.**

text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.

**[Alto Golf](/courses/alto-golf)** (par 70, 5,432 m, slope 130): the last course Sir Henry Cotton designed. It accepts a handicap of up to 36 for men as well as ladies, so it suits higher handicappers. Twilight is €50.

**[Penina Championship](/courses/penina-championship)** (par 73, 6,273 m, slope 143): Cotton's 1966 course, the first in the Algarve, which the club says has hosted the Portuguese Open ten times. Flat, but the hardest course in the area on slope.
**[Penina Resort Course](/courses/penina-resort)** (9 holes, par 35, 2,987 m): a full-length nine beside the Championship course that doesn't ask for a handicap.
**[Pestana Ferragudo](/courses/pestana-ferragudo)** (par 72, 5,841 m, slope 118): Pestana's newest course, opened in 2026, and one of the easiest 18-hole courses in the area on slope.
**[Vale da Pinta](/courses/vale-da-pinta)** (par 71, 6,127 m, slope 132): Pestana's Carvoeiro course with rolling fairways. Twilight is €55 from 3.30pm.
**[Gramacho](/courses/gramacho)** (par 72, 6,107 m, slope 132): Pestana's hillier Carvoeiro course, next to Vale da Pinta. Twilight is €55 from 3.30pm.
**[Morgado](/courses/morgado)** (par 73, 6,581 m, slope 134): golfers describe its fairways as wide and forgiving; the back nine is hillier, so a buggy is recommended.
**[Palmares](/courses/palmares)** (27 holes, slope 129 to 134): Robert Trent Jones Jr.'s course between the sea and the hills at Lagos, with three nines and real elevation changes.
Golf at Pestana Alvor Praia

Pestana calls the hotel a Premium Beach & Golf Resort, and its website mentions eight golf courses in the area. It doesn't publish a golf discount or golf shuttle for this hotel, so ask when you book whether it can arrange tee times, especially at Pestana's own Alto Golf, Vale da Pinta, Gramacho and Ferragudo courses. The hotel itself has a minigolf course and a children's playground.

Pestana's sister hotels in Alvor and the Tivoli Alvor resort are close by. Our page on [golf near Alvor](/alvor/golf-courses) lists every course within half an hour of the town, and [golf courses near Tivoli Alvor](/guide/golf-courses-near-tivoli-alvor) covers the neighbouring resort.

text: Which course to play from Pestana Alvor Praia
**For the shortest drive,** Alto Golf is 6 minutes away. Compare it with Penina in [Alto Golf vs Penina Championship](/guide/alto-golf-vs-penina-championship-which-portimao-course-should-you-play).
**For history,** play the Penina Championship course; see [Penina Championship vs Penina Resort](/guide/penina-championship-vs-penina-resort-which-course-should-you-play).
**For a higher handicap,** Alto Golf accepts up to 36 for men, and the Penina Resort Course doesn't ask for a handicap.
Getting there

Pestana Alvor Praia is about **1 hour and 76 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Portimão and Alvor for golfers](/guide/faro-airport-to-portimao-and-alvor-for-golfers).
Golf near Pestana Alvor Praia: common questions
What is the closest golf course to Pestana Alvor Praia?
Alto Golf, about 6 minutes away by car. The Penina Championship and Resort courses are about 18 minutes away.
Does Pestana Alvor Praia have a golf course?
No, only a minigolf course. Pestana runs the nearby Alto Golf course.
Do I need a handicap to play near Pestana Alvor Praia?

At the 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Alto Golf accepts 36 for men too, and the Penina Resort Course doesn't ask for one. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
